panels.main_3d_view: lg:col-span-8 lg:row-span-2 h-[600px] lg:h-full relative border border-cyan-500/30 bg-black/50 overflow-hidden

visual_effects.scanlines: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0, transparent 2px, rgba(0,240,255,0.05) 2px, rgba(0,240,255,0.05) 4px)

components_strategy.panels: Use pure HTML/Tailwind with clip-paths and custom CSS for HUD panels instead of standard Shadcn cards to ensure Tron aesthetic.
components_strategy.buttons: Flat background, sharp edges, cyan border, hover effects with text-shadow and inset box-shadow. No border-radius.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts with transparent backgrounds, cyan lines, and grid stroke opacity 0.1.
components_strategy.icons: lucide-react, styled with cyan color and subtle drop-shadow.
components_strategy.3d_scene: react-three-fiber. Use <Points> for Heatmap/Object detection. Use wireframe materials for router/devices. Black/transparent background.

login_background.description: Pitch-black background with deep blue and cyan glowing digital grid lines, suitable for the admin login screen.

router_blueprint.description: Futuristic glowing cyan wireframe of a TP-Link Archer router. Can be used in the 'Connection Detection' screen or as a 2D fallback.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire application is in German (e.g., 'Systemsteuerung', 'Signalstärke', 'Geräteverwaltung').
Install and use 'three', '@react-three/fiber' and '@react-three/drei' for the central 3D room visualization.
Implement the login screen first (Admin Login). It should feel like accessing a secure military/hacker gateway.
Simulate an 'auto-detect' sequence for the 'TP-Link Archer C6' via cable connection before showing the dashboard.
Dashboard must include 3D holographic room visualization combining a heatmap overlay and point cloud for detected objects.
Include a 'Router Control Panel' (WiFi settings, restart), 'Signal Analytics' (RSSI charts), and 'Object Detection Console' (logs).
Apply 'data-testid' to all interactive elements using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., 'admin-login-button', 'router-restart-button').
Do NOT use standard rounded corners (rounded-lg). Use sharp corners, clip-paths, and glowing borders to match the Tron/Sci-Fi aesthetic.
Add 'Orbitron' and 'Rajdhani' via Google Fonts in index.html.
Avoid generic dashboards - strictly adhere to the high-tech, futuristic Command Center vibes.
